title: Beta.11 evidence for the Composio project, org and user API keys (#434, slice g)
description: Fixtures for composio-api-key (ak_), composio-org-api-key (oak_) and composio-user-api-key (uak_), arrival families for product redact-secret#909, authored from the #860 step-3 handoff https://github.com/redact-secret/redact-secret/blob/270faf84dc12f6a4a4cf61fe3ffab7aadc4f7262/docs/audits/evidence/860/composio.md: positives in every handoff context, one-property twins, and independent benign controls. Values are synthetic, built at generation time, never provider-issued. Measures and records; moves no support status by itself.
